journal_lines: §lBlaze§l above the magma. Closed the gap between volleys.
§cFireball caught my flank. §oSmelled my own fur.§o Kept moving. Cleared it.
Spinning rods. Kept low. Got in close where the fire is harder to aim.
Heat before anything else — smell, sound, sight. Knew it was there.
Charged through the smoke on the exhale. Worth the singe.
§oIt breathes before it fires. §oShort breath. Used that.
§lBlaze§l near the stairs. Felled it before it found its range.
§cTwo fireballs, one after the other. §oSecond one clipped my ear.§o Rod in the bag after.
Rods still warm when I picked them up. Packed them carefully.
Moved sideways between shots. Closed the distance in five moves.
§oRoom smelled like a forge that had been running for a hundred years.§o Still had to clear it.
Light winked out when it fell. Dark came fast in there.
